free_design.Place: An empty late-night capsule tram car with a dark observation window and a few low amber ceiling lights.
free_design.Activity: She is folding a used blank tram ticket into a little star as the city lights drift by.
free_design.Pose: Sitting upright three-quarter toward the camera, head inclined slightly toward her work. Both forearms are raised in front of her waist, each hand pinching a separate side of the same paper, with the wrists separated.
free_design.Framing: Portrait 2:3, mid-thigh to head at eye height with the pale paper centered and the night skyline beyond the opposite window.
free_design.Outfit: A fitted opaque rust-orange rib-knit bolero with angular cap sleeves over an indigo asymmetric jersey romper and low leather boots.
